g.text: Absorption-first cascade for ophthalmic-systemic DDI screening
40 mechanism rules, an absorption-scaled class matrix and a hard constraint; no model call on the production path
WHERE THE 26,216 REGISTRY PAIRS ARE DECIDED
21 by 34 classes, 104 defined cells, absorption-scaled in-layer
low absorption and no other signal
no rule and no defined cell
One grade per pair, with rule IDs, decision path and evidence chain.
final grade = max(L1, L2); grades are high, medium or low
1,307 evidence chunks, graded A to E, each with a source record
Checks: every decision returns matched rule IDs and a path; no model call or network access.
